articles.title: j-hope: LV Icon, K-Pop’s Eternal Sunshine
articles.description: *Photography courtesy of Esquire Korea, BigHit Music — j-hope, Louis Vuitton. All rights reserved. In the electric glow of Seoul’s neon skyline, j-hope emerges as more than a performer—he’s a beacon. Gracing Esquire Korea’s May 2026 covers in Louis Vuitton finery, the BTS powerhouse redefines K-pop’s fusion of rhythm, rebellion, and runway swagger. From Street Dancer to Global Force Picture a young Jung Ho-seok, threading Gwangju’s bustling streets, body moving like liquid fire to hip-hop beats.
articles.summary: j-hope from BTS appears on Esquire Korea's May 2026 cover wearing Louis Vuitton, showcasing his evolution from street dancer in Gwangju to global K-pop star.

articles.title: Dressed in Heritage: How BTS’s Fashion Language Is Rewriting Global Style in 2026
articles.description: All images courtesy of Rolling Stone / © 2026 Rolling Stone LLC. All rights reserved. Photographed in Seoul, February 2026. There is a photograph from the May 2026 Rolling Stone cover shoot that stops you cold. Seven men, each alone in their own frame, each a self-contained universe of intention. RM wears a shiny black leather jacket over oversize parachute pants, chunky boots, hair frosted at the tips — the kind of look you’d have to be a member of BTS to pull off. Rolling Stone Across the eigh
articles.summary: Rolling Stone featured BTS in a May 2026 cover shoot photographed in Seoul, showcasing the group's distinctive fashion choices including RM in a black leather jacket and oversized parachute pants. The article explores how BTS's fashion influences global style trends through their incorporation of heritage elements.
